event_chain.summary: Claimed theft of 300K user records, selfies and source code

summary: In November 2023 hackers claimed to have breached defunct US Bitcoin ATM operator Coin Cloud, which filed for bankruptcy in February 2023, and to hold data on more than 300,000 users in the US and Brazil, including about 70,000 customer selfies taken by ATM cameras, names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, emails, phone numbers, occupations and addresses, plus the company's full backend source code. No confirmation from Coin Cloud was reported.
